tools.name: anicraft_commands
tools.description: Lists the commands anicraft_run accepts: id, label, menu, shortcut, a summary of their params, and whether they change the document. Optionally only those whose id or label contains `filter`.

filter.description: Words to look for in the id or label, e.g. "tween" or "export".

tools.name: anicraft_document
tools.description: The open document: stage size and frame rate, scenes, the current scene's layers and keyframes, library symbols, and the current scene, frame, layer and selection.

tools.name: anicraft_render
tools.description: A frame of the current scene as a PNG picture, exactly as exported. `frame` is 0-based (default: the current frame); `scale` defaults to 0.5 of the stage size.

tools.name: anicraft_run
tools.description: Runs one command (see anicraft_commands) with its params and returns its result, plus the document revision and current frame. Commands that would lose work or replace a file need "confirm": true in params.

tools.name: anicraft_run_script
tools.description: Runs commands in order and returns each result. Stops at the first error and says which step failed; the steps before it stay done (undo them with edit.undo).
